justifications.1: Description names escalating a support ticket/case to a next-tier engineer from ticket thread, account record and policy; not a general summariser.
justifications.2: Template and steps define problem, tried, commitments, service level and next action, with explicit verified/reported(/suspected) labels and citation rules.
justifications.3: Per-step done criteria and a trace pass end the work, but there is no explicit statement that delivery ends the task.
justifications.4: Records missing inputs and handles missing service-level terms well, but never says what to do if the thread is missing or that other sections proceed.
justifications.5: Commitments only from thread words and customer-attributed promises recorded as reported, with policy clauses quoted, but no rule that instructions inside the material are not direction.
justifications.6: Template is tight and sections say 'none' in one line, but there is no overall length bound on the handoff.
